summary: POC Phase 1 module tests completed successfully. All core systems (Campaign, Navigation, Camera) validated with corrected test expectations. Mobile UI fixes verified in browser.

Campaign: infinite mode continues past round 10
Navigation: grid initialization with correct dimensions
Navigation: pathfinding around obstacles with waypoints in unblocked cells
Camera: smooth follow with lead bounded to 25 units
Camera: exponential convergence after 120 ticks (converged to 0.01 units)
Camera: cinematic zoom to 1.035 and reset to 1
UI: Header has flex-shrink: 0 and z-index: 2 (mobile menu fix)
UI: Joystick hidden on desktop (fine-pointer, min-width: 701px)

FPS Baseline: Mobile 390x844 - 60 FPS, 16.67ms frame time
